name: Messelia
source:
A human dancer with a very cheerful personality.
When the protagonist arrives at Bustington Castle, she is invited to dance at the welcome banquet.
She is a bit capricious. She can be a bit impudent, but she is devoted to those whom she likes.

I'm pretty expensive, you know. I won't let a normal person like you hold me.
